name: lean

pipeline.tier_reason: the proofs section has Lean's kernel check every rule theorem it emits (skipped, with its reason, on a host with no Lean toolchain); the theorems section holds Lean-imported cards to it

statement: Lean is the proof kernel: theorems, logic derivations and imported statements are checked by Lean, fail-closed.
usefulness: Proofs written in Lean become the model's knowledge, and the model's derivations become Lean proofs.
